title: Moratorium period (60 months)
rule: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no policy or claim can be contested on grounds of non-disclosure or misrepresentation, except established fraud.
fails_when: Rejection is for non-disclosure/misrepresentation AND computed months_of_cover >= 60 AND the letter does not allege and establish fraud.
policy_clause_hint: Moratorium / Disclosure of Information clause (sample policy: Clause 6.4, Clause 6.1)

title: Pre-existing disease waiting (max 36 months)
rule: Waiting period for pre-existing diseases cannot exceed 36 months of continuous coverage.
fails_when: Letter applies a PED waiting period longer than 36 months, or longer than the policy states, or rejects a declared PED after months_of_cover >= the policy's PED waiting period.

title: Specified disease waiting period
rule: Specified disease/procedure waiting period applies only until it is complete (max 36 months); it does not apply to accidents.
fails_when: Letter applies a longer period than the policy states, or months_of_cover >= the policy's specified-disease waiting period, or the claim arose from an accident.

title: 24-hour rule vs Day Care procedures
rule: The 24-hour minimum hospitalisation does not apply to Day Care procedures listed in the policy.
fails_when: Rejected for hospitalisation under 24 hours AND the procedure appears in the policy's Day Care list.
policy_clause_hint: Hospitalisation / Day Care definitions and Day Care annexure (sample policy: Clause 1.5, 2.2, Annexure I)
regulation: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance, 2024; consumer forum rulings

title: Claims Review Committee approval
rule: No claim may be repudiated fully or partly without approval of the insurer's Claims Review Committee.
fails_when: The rejection letter does not state Claims Review Committee approval.
regulation: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance, 2024

title: Specific clause cited
rule: Every repudiation must state the specific policy clause under which the claim is declined.
fails_when: The letter names a clause only vaguely or gives no clause number.
regulation: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance, 2024

title: Grievance & Ombudsman options shared
rule: The insurer must tell the insured about grievance redressal and Ombudsman options.
fails_when: The letter does not mention the grievance officer, Bima Bharosa or the Ombudsman.
policy_clause_hint: Repudiation / Grievance clause (sample policy: Clause 5.4, Section 7)
regulation: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance, 2024

title: Documents collected by insurer
rule: The insurer/TPA must collect documents from the hospital; a claim cannot be rejected for documents the hospital holds.
fails_when: Rejected for documents not submitted when those documents are available with the hospital.
regulation: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance, 2024

title: Sum insured & sub-limits
rule: Payable amount = minimum of bill, applicable sub-limit and sum insured.
fails_when: Only used to compute amount_at_stake_inr; mark fail only if the insurer applied a sub-limit wrongly.
